cards.text: Welcome to the bakery, friend. We're in the book of Judges, and Israel is living in the land right alongside other nations. And the Israelites do evil in the sight of the LORD. They forget the LORD their God.

cards.question: Israel forgets the LORD their God. Who do they serve instead?

cards.text: The anger of the LORD burns against Israel, and He sells them into the hand of Cushan-rishathaim, king of Aram-naharaim. Friend, I tried saying that name ONE time and my mustache tied itself in a knot.

cards.question: The Israelites serve Cushan-rishathaim for ___ years.
After eight years under a foreign king, the Israelites turn somewhere for help. Where do they turn?

answers.text: They cry out to the LORD
They pray harder to the Baals

cards.text: The LORD raises up a deliverer to save them: Othniel, son of Caleb's younger brother Kenaz. Look at that, friend. They cry out, and help is on the way.

cards.question: When Othniel is raised up as Israel's deliverer, the ___ of the LORD comes upon him.

cards.text: Othniel becomes Israel's judge and goes out to war, and the LORD delivers the king of Aram into his hand. Eight years of trouble, and it's over in one verse. Othniel prevails.

cards.question: True or false: after Othniel prevails, the land has rest for forty years, until Othniel dies.

cards.text: Forty years of rest, and then once again the Israelites do evil in the sight of the LORD. That's me with the snooze button, friend: "NEVER again," and the next morning, there goes my mustache, right back on it.

cards.question: Because Israel has done evil, the LORD gives ___ king of Moab power over Israel.

cards.text: Eglon doesn't come alone. He enlists the Ammonites and the Amalekites, attacks and defeats Israel, and takes the City of Palms.

cards.question: True or false: Israel serves Eglon king of Moab for less time than they served Cushan-rishathaim.

cards.text: Eighteen years under Eglon. Then again they cry out to the LORD, and He raises up a deliverer: Ehud son of Gera, from the tribe of Benjamin.

cards.question: The Bible makes sure we know one detail about Ehud, Israel's new deliverer. What is it?

cards.text: Israel sends Ehud to bring their tribute to Eglon king of Moab. But Ehud has made himself a double-edged sword, a cubit long, and he hides it under his cloak.

cards.question: Remember, Ehud is left-handed. Where does he strap his sword under his cloak?

cards.text: Ehud brings the tribute to Eglon king of Moab, who was an obese man. Once the tribute is presented, Ehud sends off the men who carried it.
Ehud has delivered Israel's tribute to Eglon king of Moab, and the men who carried it are on their way. But near the idols at Gilgal, Ehud himself turns back.

cards.question: Ehud walks back in to King Eglon by himself. What does he tell the king?

answers.text: I have a secret message for you
I have more tribute for you
I have come to make peace

cards.text: The king says, "Silence," and all his attendants walk out. Friend, I've never cleared a room that fast, and I once burned a batch so bad the smoke alarm filed a complaint.

cards.question: Ehud approaches Eglon, sitting alone in his cool upper room, and says he has a word from God for him. True or false: the king stays in his seat.

cards.text: The king rises, and Ehud reaches with his left hand, pulls the sword from his right thigh, and plunges it into Eglon's belly.

cards.question: The sword goes in so deep that even the handle sinks in after the blade. What does Ehud do with the sword?

answers.text: He drops it by the door

cards.text: Eglon's fat closes over the sword, and his bowels empty. Ehud heads out through the porch.

cards.question: On his way out, Ehud closes and ___ the doors of the upper room behind him.

cards.text: Once Ehud is gone, Eglon's servants come in and find the doors of the upper room locked.

cards.question: The doors of the upper room are locked. What do Eglon's servants figure the king is doing in there?

answers.text: Relieving himself in the cool room
Resting up in the cool room

cards.text: So they wait until they get worried, and the doors still haven't opened. You know this one, friend: standing outside a door, checking your phone, nobody brave enough to knock.

cards.question: Finally the servants take the ___ and open the doors, and there's their lord, lying dead on the floor.
True or false: while Eglon's servants wait outside the doors, Ehud hides somewhere inside the palace.

cards.text: All that awkward waiting gave Ehud his head start, and now he's arrived in Seirah. Eglon king of Moab is dead behind him. Now it's time to call Israel together.

cards.question: In Seirah, how does Ehud call the Israelites to him?

answers.text: He sends runners to the tribes

cards.text: The horn sounds throughout the hill country of Ephraim, and the Israelites come down from the hills with him. Ehud becomes their leader.

cards.question: Ehud tells the Israelites to follow him. True or false: he tells them the LORD has delivered the Moabites into their hand.

cards.text: So they follow him down and seize the fords of the Jordan leading to Moab.

cards.question: Israel is holding the river crossings that lead to Moab. What do they do there?
At that time, Israel strikes down about ten thousand Moabites, all robust and valiant men. True or false: a handful of them escape.

cards.text: Moab is subdued under the hand of Israel that day. Years of serving Moab, and it all turns around in ONE day.

cards.question: After Moab is subdued, the land has rest for ___ years.

cards.text: After Ehud comes Shamgar son of Anath, and he too saves Israel.

cards.question: Shamgar strikes down six hundred Philistines. What does he use?

cards.text: Six hundred Philistines, and Shamgar does it with a farm tool. Me? I've got a whole bakery full of tools, friend, and I STILL lose arguments with the timer.
